text: dsh-pins 是 DSH Web 插件，可把聊天选段固定到右侧面板，并按会话保存在浏览器本地。用户可给片段加标签、搜索筛选、排序并点击卡片回到原文，也可把选段引用到输入框，或导出 Markdown 提纲。适合阅读长对话时标记重点、回看原文和整理引用；需要 DSH Web，不需 API 密钥或额外账号。

dsh-pins adds a pinned-passages panel to DSH Web. It saves selected chat text locally by session, with tags, search and sorting. Click a card to revisit its source, quote it in the composer, or export a Markdown outline. It helps organize highlights from long chats and needs no API key.
想把聊天里选中的重点存起来，之后能快速找回。
能不能把一段对话固定在侧边栏，再点一下回到原文？
我想给保存的聊天片段加标签，方便分类。
让 DSH 能按关键词搜索我以前标记的内容。
I want to save key passages from a chat and jump back to their exact source later.
Can I organize conversation highlights with tags and search them across sessions?
I need to turn selected chat excerpts into quotes or a Markdown outline.
dsh-pins 的功能「固定对话选段」：将聊天消息中的选中文本保存为会话片段，并保留消息标识、文本锚点和偏移信息。通过选区浮条固定，片段写入浏览器本地存储。
dsh-pins 的功能「回到原文」：点击侧栏中的片段卡片后，插件定位并滚动到来源消息及匹配选段；若无法精确匹配，则回退到整条消息。
dsh-pins 的功能「标签与筛选」：在片段卡片上管理标签，并在面板中搜索文本或标签、按标签筛选片段。用户可在本会话视图和全部会话视图中整理内容。
dsh-pins 的功能「引用与 Markdown 导出」：在输入框中将固定片段作为引用内容插入消息，也可把当前视图中的片段、标签及来源信息整理成 Markdown 提纲并下载。
我想把聊天里挑出的几句话汇总成 Markdown 笔记。

dsh-pins README · 固定片段 · dsh-pins：**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

> 把对话里划选的段落固定到右侧栏，像便签一样排成一列；点一下跳回原文，打 `@` 引用进消息。

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的 Web UI 插件。读长回复时最容易丢的东西是"我刚刚读到哪、哪几句是关键"——划选、固定、回头看，就这么一件事。

dsh-pins README · 安装：需要 Harness 的 Web 界面（`dsh web`）。一条命令，装完会**自动把这个 bundle 选进 profile**：

```bash
dsh-pins README · 从 GitHub 安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:ylw-ux/dsh-pins-fixtool
dsh-pins README · 已发布到 npm 之后：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pins

dsh-pins README · 从本地目录安装（开发用，会建立 link 依赖，改完刷新页面即可）：- **不需要 pnpm 构建授权。** 这个包没有任何 `prepare` / `postinstall` 脚本，也没有构建步骤——纯 JavaScript，装完即可用，不会弹 "allow build scripts"。
- **不会动你的 profile 配置以外的任何东西。** 它只往 profile 的 `package.json` 加一条依赖、往 `dsh.profile.bundles` 加一个名字，以及自己的一份 patch 行。
- **数据在你自己的浏览器里。** 固定片段存在 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-pins/v1`），不上传、不同步、没有账号。清除站点数据即全部删除。
- 装好后左栏底部（Settings 旁边）会出现带条数的「固定片段」入口；也可以在右侧栏页签里打开它。

text:
dsh-pins README · 用法：| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 划选文字 | 选区上方浮出动作条：**固定 / 标签 / 固定并引用 / 引用 / 复制** |
| `Alt` + `P` | 固定或取消固定当前选区 |
| 鼠标停在卡片上 | 卡片原地展开（上限 `min(60cqh, 420px)`），可在卡片内滚动看全文 |
| 点卡片正文 | **永远 = 跳回原文**，落到选中的那段文字并居中 |
| 卡片上的 `#` / `❞` / `⧉` / `✕` | 编辑标签 / 引用到输入框 / 复制原文 / 取消固定 |
| 输入框里打 `@` | 菜单第一行就是「固定片段」；进去后**再打字就是搜索**（正文、标签都比对），选中即插入一个**引用芯片** |
| 点输入框里的引用芯片 | 打开右侧栏，并让那条卡片脉冲高亮 |
| 面板顶部 | 两个视图（本对话 / 全部）、四种排序、搜索、多选标签筛选、标签管理、markdown 提纲导出 |
| 两个视图的筛选 | **各留一份**：在「全部」里选的标签和搜索词不会跟着你去「本对话」，切回来时它们还在原处。排序是全局偏好，两边共用并会被记住 |
dsh-pins README · 用法：引用有两种形态，**都自带内容、都不是指针**：一是直接把带出处的引用块放进输入框；二是插入一个**引用芯片**，发送前由插件把它换成完整引用。两种形态的原文都真的进消息——模型看得到内容，发送后也永不过期。

dsh-pins README · 它不做什么：- **不解析 markdown、不存 HTML 快照。** 固定的是你选中的文本、它所在的轮次与偏移，可读、可迁移。
- **不自动切换你的对话。** 在「全部」里点别的对话的卡片只会说明情况，不会把你正在读的会话换掉。
- **不注入上下文。** 没有任何"把固定片段偷偷塞进模型上下文"的行为；要么你引用，要么模型显式来读（后者尚未实现）。
- **不写任何隐性状态。** 固定是显式动作，删除是显式动作。

dsh-pins README · 已知限制：- **只支持 Web（`platform: web`）。** TUI / Desktop 没有这一层界面。
- **锚点依赖宿主的 DOM 契约**（`data-chat-flow-key`、`data-chat-turn`、`[data-conversation-scroll]`）。宿主若整批改名，持久标记与精确跳转会一起失效——**数据本身不会丢**（存的仍是文本、轮次、偏移），并且跳转有按位置的降级回退。这是这个插件唯一无法自证的风险，如实写在这里。
- **超过 2000 字的选区只保留前 2000 字**：浮条与固定成功的提示会当场说明，卡片上也会标「已截断」。引用与芯片吃同一个上限。1.0.4 之前保存的片段只有前 600 字，那部分无法恢复。
- **同一段文字在一条消息里出现多次**时，定位会挑离记录偏移最近且文本校验通过的那个；都不通过就退回整条消息并标「原文未找到」。

dsh-pins README · 兼容性：在本机验证过的组合：**DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` · Node `24.14.1` · pnpm `12.6.0`**（1.0.3 及更早版本验证于 `0.2.0-rc.2`）。

包内**没有声明 `peerDependencies`，也没有声明 `engines.dsh`**——这是有意的：它不 import 任何 Harness 包（客户端半边只 `require('react')`，宿主半边是一个空的 `apply`），所有宿主交互都做了存在性检查并在缺失时降级或明确报错。声明一个我没法验证的版本范围，只会让安装被挡住。

dsh-pins README · 开发：```
dsh-pins/
├── package.json         bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml     往 profile 里插一行
├── index.js             宿主半边（预留的 pinsHost 服务，目前为空）

本地开发用 `dsh plugin --profile web add <绝对路径>` 装成 link 依赖，改 `client.js` 后刷新页面即可；`plugin_manager` 工具与 Web 的 Plugins 页面管理的是同一份 profile 状态。

dsh-pins README · Pinned passages · dsh-pins：[中文](README.md) | **English**

> Pin selected passages from a conversation into a right-sidebar note wall. Click one to jump back to its source, or type `@` in the composer to quote it into your message.

A Web UI plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai). What gets lost while reading a long reply is *where was I, and which sentences actually mattered* — select, pin, come back. That is the whole of it.

dsh-pins README · Install：Requires the Harness Web UI (`dsh web`). One command — it also **selects the bundle into your profile** for you:

```bash
dsh-pins README · from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:ylw-ux/dsh-pins-fixtool
dsh-pins README · once published to npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pins

dsh-pins README · apply after a page refresh)：dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-pins
```

Then **refresh the browser**. If nothing happens, restart `dsh`.

Uninstall:bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pins
```

Worth knowing:

dsh-pins README · apply after a page refresh)：- **No pnpm build approval.** The package has no `prepare` / `postinstall` script and no build step — plain JavaScript, usable the moment it installs, no "allow build scripts" prompt.
- **It touches nothing outside your profile.** It adds one dependency to the profile's `package.json`, one name to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and its own patch row.
- **Your data stays in your browser.** Passages live in `localStorage` (key `dsh-pins/v1`): never uploaded, never synced, no account. Clearing site data deletes all of it.
- A 「固定片段」 entry with a count appears at the foot of the left sidebar (next to Settings); the side panel can also be opened from its tab in the right column.

dsh-pins README · Usage：| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| Select text | An action bar appears above the selection: **Pin / Tag / Pin and quote / Quote / Copy** |
| `Alt` + `P` | Pin or unpin the current selection |
| Hover a card | The card expands in place (capped at `min(60cqh, 420px)`), scrollable inside |
| Click a card's text | **Always jumps back to the source**, centred on the selected passage |
| `#` / `❞` / `⧉` / `✕` on a card | Edit tags / quote into the composer / copy the raw text / unpin |
| Type `@` in the composer | The first row is 「固定片段」; once inside, **typing filters it** (matching text and tags) and picking inserts a **reference chip** |
| Click a reference chip | Opens the side panel and pulses that card |
| Panel header | Two views (this conversation / all), four sort orders, search, multi-select tag filter, tag management, Markdown outline export |
| Filters in the two views | **Kept separately**: a tag or search term chosen in 「全部」 does not follow you into 「本对话」, and is still there when you come back. Sort order is a global preference and is remembered |

dsh-pins README · Usage：Quoting comes in two shapes, and **both carry their content — neither is a pointer**: a quote block pasted straight into the composer with its source line, or a **reference chip** that the plugin expands into the full quote just before sending. Either way the passage really reaches the model, and never expires afterwards.

dsh-pins README · What it does not do：- **No Markdown parsing, no HTML snapshots.** What is stored is the text you selected, plus its turn and offset — readable and portable.
- **It never switches your conversation.** Clicking a card from another conversation in 「全部」 explains itself instead of moving you out of what you are reading.
- **No context injection.** Nothing is ever quietly pushed into the model's context; either you quote it, or the model asks for it explicitly (the latter is not implemented yet).
- **No hidden state.** Pinning is an explicit action, and so is deleting.

dsh-pins README · Known limitations：- **Web only** (`platform: web`). TUI and Desktop have no such surface.
- **Anchors depend on the host's DOM contract** (`data-chat-flow-key`, `data-chat-turn`, `[data-conversation-scroll]`). If the host renames them all at once, durable marks and precise jumps break together — **your data does not** (it is still text, turn and offset), and jumping degrades to a position-based fallback. This is the one risk the plugin cannot verify for itself, so it is written down here.
- **A selection longer than 2000 characters is kept as its first 2000** (the toolbar and the success notice say so at capture time, and the card marks it 「已截断」). Quotes and chips share that ceiling. Passages saved before 1.0.4 hold only their first 600 characters, and that part cannot be recovered.
- **When the same text appears several times in one message**, the jump picks the occurrence nearest the recorded offset that also passes a text check; if none does, it falls back to the whole message and marks the card 「原文未找到」.

dsh-pins README · Compatibility：Verified on: **DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` · Node `24.14.1` · pnpm `12.6.0`** (1.0.3 and earlier were verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`).

The package declares **no `peerDependencies` and no `engines.dsh`**, deliberately: it imports no Harness package (the browser half only `require`s `react`; the host half is an empty `apply`), and every host interaction is feature-checked and either degrades or reports clearly. Declaring a version range I cannot verify would only block installs.

dsh-pins README · Development：```
dsh-pins/
├── package.json         bundle manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml     inserts one row into the profile
├── index.js             host half (a reserved pinsHost service, currently empty)

For local development, `dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute path>` installs it as a link dependency; edit `client.js` and refresh the page. The `plugin_manager` tool and the Web Plugins page manage the same profile state.
dsh-pins README · License：[MIT](LICENSE)
